propositions: git stash stack is shared across all worktrees in a repository, causing stash entries created in one worktree to be popped into the tickets worktree

the stash->merge->pop dance in push.py assumed only reconciler-regenerable files would be stashed, but source files can be stashed from other branches, leaving the tickets index stranded with unmerged entries and blocking all subsequent store writes
rebar must perform no git stash operations in the tickets worktree and instead use sha-addressed commit objects (git stash create + apply) that cannot reference another worktree's stash stack
a tickets worktree containing tracked source paths should be reported by fsck as foreign pollution and healed by auto-discarding paths not present on origin/tickets and not ticket-shaped

a supported maintenance entrypoint must exist to mutate the tracker safely, with backup-before-first-write, refusal on unpushed commits, durable audit logging, and a break-glass override for unforeseen cases
